note: ORPHAN Pro 24:10 — if you faint in the day of adversity, your strength is small.

dims.v: faintheartedness — collapsing in the day of trouble reveals a small strength

the fainting in the day of adversity that exposes how small one's strength is — the faintheartedness that gives way under pressure, adversity testing and revealing the true measure of a soul's fortitude
welded to the meagre strength the collapse exposes

raphah (grow faint/slack) — 'if you FAINT in the day of adversity, your strength is small' (24:10); trouble is the test of strength. To collapse under pressure reveals a fortitude that was never great. Adversity does not make character; it shows it.
exposed weakness — the meagre fortitude revealed by fainting in trouble
the smallness of strength that fainting in adversity lays bare — the fortitude proven meagre when tested, strength measured not in ease but in the day of trouble
welded to the collapse that exposes it

koach (strength) — 'your STRENGTH is small' (24:10); strength is measured in adversity. The one who faints when tested shows a fortitude that was small all along. Real strength holds in the day of trouble.
